explication: SFTPGo is an event-driven file-transfer server supporting SFTP, HTTP/S, FTP/S, and WebDAV, with local, encrypted, and cloud/remote storage backends. The main workflow is a client connecting through a protocol server, authenticating against configured account data, and transferring files through a virtual filesystem to its storage backend. The tree and README establish the major protocol, UI/API, storage, and automation capabilities; sampled server excerpts confirm some server startup and authentication paths, but not every protocol-to-storage call, so uncertain wiring is omitted.
